caption:
A backup turns a disaster into a bad afternoon. 💾

1. Install a backup plugin (UpdraftPlus has a free version)
2. Set an automatic schedule
3. Send copies off your site (cloud storage)
4. Test a restore once

scenes.title: Set up backups

right.title: Cloud storage
right.text: Safe if the site is gone.

scenes.say: Backups on the same server can be lost along with your site. Copies in cloud storage stay safe.
